question: Wicker Warcrawler puts its -1/-1 counter on itself at end of combat. Does it shrink before combat damage is dealt, as Dusk Urchins does?

expected.shortAnswer: No: the -1/-1 counter is put on at end of combat, after combat damage has already been dealt.
expected.answer: The -1/-1 counter is put on Wicker Warcrawler at end of combat, after combat damage has already been dealt. (Note that this is different from how Dusk Urchins works.)
